articles.title: Robot Pool Cleaners That Do the Dirty Work (So You Don't Have To!)
articles.summary: Imagine a robot that scrubs your pool while you chill. Beatbot's cleaners are on sale, and the fanciest one uses AI to spot dirt. It even floats back up when the battery is low.

articles.title: Tennis Star Andy Murray Joins Jack Draper's Team as a Coach!
articles.summary: Andy Murray, a three-time Grand Slam champ, is now coaching his friend Jack Draper for the grass season. They've been pals for years—Draper even calls Murray his 'big brother.'

articles.title: Coco Gauff's Incredible Comeback: From Match Point Down to Victory!
articles.summary: Coco Gauff was one point away from losing to teenager Iva Jovic in Rome. But she fought back, winning 5-7, 7-5, 6-2. Even fighter jets roaring overhead couldn't stop her!
